hooks.command: echo 'Skill-MAS default routing is active. Before planning ordinary substantive coding, research, retrieval, reasoning, or tool tasks, load skill-mas:skill-mas with the Skill tool. Select its profiles automatically and compose with available specialist skills. Keep one orchestration owner if another workflow already coordinates the task; avoid duplicate teams or recursive skill invocation. Simple questions and small indivisible edits can be handled directly. Respect user opt-outs, repository instructions, permissions, and actual tool availability. Subagents stay within their assigned scope. Do not ask the user to type a skill command or choose a profile. Keep normal progress and required approvals visible.'
